questions.question_text: In dance terminology, what does the term 'Karanas' primarily refer to?
options: C) Coordinated movements of the hands and feet
D) The speed of the music
questions.answer: C) Coordinated movements of the hands and feet

questions.question_text: Which traditional Indian theatre form uses leather puppets manipulated from behind a white screen illuminated by a light source?
In the context of theatrical production, what is the primary function of a 'prop' (property)?
options: A) The script used by actors
B) Moveable objects used by actors on stage during a performance
questions.answer: B) Moveable objects used by actors on stage during a performance

questions.question_text: What does 'Navarasa' represent in classical Indian dance and theatre?
options: B) Nine fundamental human emotions or sentiments
questions.answer: B) Nine fundamental human emotions or sentiments

sections.section_name: Section B - Theory Short Answer Concepts

questions.question_text: Define the term 'Choreography' and explain its importance in group dance performances. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Choreography is the art of designing and arranging sequences of movements. In group dances, it is vital for ensuring synchronization, spatial awareness, and visually harmonious patterns.

questions.question_text: List the three main components essential for a basic theatrical performance. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The three essential components for a basic theatrical performance are the actors (performers), the script (or story/narrative), and an audience to view the performance.

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of 'Abhinaya' in Indian classical dance. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Abhinaya refers to the art of expression. It involves using facial expressions, hand gestures (mudras), and body language to convey the story and emotions to the audience.

questions.question_text: How does stage lighting affect the mood of a theatre play? Give one example. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Stage lighting sets the emotional tone. For example, dim, blue lighting can create a sad or suspenseful mood, while bright, warm lights can indicate happiness or daytime.

questions.question_text: Describe what 'Mixed Media' means in the context of visual and performing arts integration. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Mixed media involves combining different artistic mediums within a single work, such as blending live dance with projected video backgrounds and recorded soundscapes to enhance storytelling.

sections.section_name: Section C - Practical Tasks: Composition & Observation

questions.question_text: Create a storyboard containing four distinct sequential panels illustrating a short narrative about 'A Dancer Preparing for the Stage'. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Evaluation Criteria: Assess logical flow across the four panels. Marks are awarded for varied camera angles (e.g., close-up on makeup, wide shot of the stage). Clean line work, expressive character poses, and brief captions describing the action in each frame are required.

questions.question_text: Design a costume concept sketch for a character portraying the 'Spirit of Fire' in a theatrical play, labeling the materials used. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Evaluation Criteria: Focus on the kinetic flow of the costume to mimic flames. Use of warm colors (reds, oranges, yellows). Clear labeling of suggested fabrics (e.g., silk for flowing movement, sequins for sparks) and practical wearability for the performer are essential.

sections.section_name: Section D - Practical Tasks: Applied Design & Messaging

questions.question_text: Design an eye-catching promotional poster for a school cultural festival integrating music, dance, and theatre, titled 'Harmony Arts Fest'. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Evaluation Criteria: The layout must effectively balance text and imagery. Include symbols representing all three arts (e.g., a mask, musical notes, dance ghungroos). Bold typography for the title, legible date/venue details, and a cohesive, vibrant color palette that attracts attention are required for maximum marks.

questions.question_text: Create a mask design on paper intended for a shadow puppetry performance, focusing on strong silhouettes and exaggerated features. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Evaluation Criteria: The design must prioritize a strong, recognizable outer silhouette over internal details. Exaggerated facial features (large nose, dramatic hair) should be drawn clearly. Heavy contrast using only black and white to simulate how the puppet will block light during the performance is crucial.
